comment: Optional M01 supply spaces through normal human movement. Static alcove and maintenance overlook; no secret counter or hidden required weapon.

states.name: confiscation_alcove
states.note: A recessed medkit beside the property lockers rewards a deliberate detour. It is not required by either route.

states.name: overlook_cache
states.note: Optional armor occupies the quiet landing corner, away from the required walking route.

states.name: maintenance_overlook
states.note: The low rail frames the service stair and machinery. The authoritative armor claim is covered by the cache lifecycle test.

states.name: return_to_route
states.note: The detour returns to the existing records approach without a jump or gate.
